create_fps_augmenter: create a VideoAugmenterByFPSChange instance with a target FPS value to change video frame rate
run_fps_change: run the FPS augmenters add_augmenter method to apply frame rate changes to a video file
get_ffmpeg_command: get the FFMPEG command list from get_command for changing a videos frame rate
review_fps_augmenter: review the VideoAugmenterByFPSChange class and its get_command method for frame rate augmentation
test_fps_augmenter: test the VideoAugmenterByFPSChange class by creating an instance and calling get_command with video paths
